events.verdict: Replay review of the foul called on Reaves (LAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Reaves makes contact to Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) arm, which affects his ability to secure the rebound. There is no illegal contact by Kennard (MEM) on the play.
Davis (LAL) and Edey (MEM) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Reaves (LAL) leans forwards after he establishes himself in a screening position in Edey's (MEM) path but the contact is marginal.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Davis (LAL) and any ensuing contact with Davis's hand once the ball is loose is incidental.
Pippen Jr. (MEM) is established in a position in front of Davis (LAL) and he does not deliver contact.
Pippen Jr. (MEM) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Reaves (LAL) on the perimeter.
Edey (MEM) is late to establish himself in a screening position and he delivers contact to Knecht (LAL).
Smart (MEM) reaches in and initiates contact with James' (LAL) arm, which causes him to lose his balance and control of the ball.
James (LAL) does not commit a traveling violation after standing up as he secures the loose ball and he legally starts his dribble.
Davis (LAL) and Jackson Jr. (MEM) make incidental contact with each other as they pursue the rebound.
Pippen Jr. (MEM) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect the rebound away from Davis (LAL).

James (LAL) jumps to the side and behind Jackson Jr. (MEM) to contest the jump shot attempt and Jackson Jr. extends his legs behind him to create the contact. Although James places an arm against Jackson Jr. during his shooting motion, the contact is marginal and does not affect his ability to return to the floor.
Smart (MEM) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with James' (LAL) arm on the perimeter.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Pippen Jr. (MEM) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Pippen Jr. wraps his right arm around Reaves' (LAL) hip and uses him as leverage in order to deflect the pass out of bounds. Although the ball goes out of bounds, the contact by Pippen Jr. is illegal and the foul is deemed proximate to the play.
James (LAL) commits a take foul on Smart (MEM). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
James (LAL) raises his arm to reach for the loose ball and the contact with Aldama's (MEM) arm during his put-back shot attempt is marginal.
Kennard (MEM) commits a take foul on Davis (LAL).
Reddish (LAL) avoids making any contact with Jackson Jr. (MEM) during the jump shot attempt.
